timeline.text:
Good morning, Tasha, this is Angie at Bonny Oaks. Good for you for having it checked before you sign anything, Tasha; if it were my money I'd do the same. The inspection is $149.95 and takes about an hour and a half: a road test, up on the lift, and a written report you can take back to the seller. I can take it as a drop-off Wednesday at 8:00 or Wednesday at 8:30. Which is easier with the lot?
Angie

timeline.text: Thank you, Tasha. Wednesday at 8:30 works. See you then at 6340 Bonny Oaks Drive.

You're set, Tasha: Wednesday at 8:30, pre-purchase inspection on the 2015 Pilot, here at 6340 Bonny Oaks Drive. Ask the lot for the keys and any service records they have, and I'll go over the report with you before you leave.
Angie
